ayahs.arabicText: الٓمّٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَا رَیْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: This Book, beyond all doubt, was revealed by the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُ١ۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّاۤ اَتٰىهُمْ مِّنْ نَّذِیْرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say: “He has fabricated it?” Nay, it is the Truth from your Lord so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you; perhaps they will be guided to the Right Way.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا فِیْ سِتَّةِ اَیَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ١ؕ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ وَّلِیٍّ وَّ لَا شَفِیْعٍ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between the two, in six days, and then He established Himself on the Throne. You have no guardian or intercessor other than He. Will you, then, not take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: یُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ یَعْرُجُ اِلَیْهِ فِیْ یَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗۤ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He governs from the heaven to the earth and then the record (of this governance) goes up to Him in a day whose measure is a thousand years in your reckoning.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الْغَیْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: He knows all that is beyond as well as all that is within a creature's sense-perception. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate,

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْۤ اَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ خَلَقَهٗ وَ بَدَاَ خَلْقَ الْاِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: He Who excelled in the creation of all that He created. He originated the creation of man from clay,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّآءٍ مَّهِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: then made his progeny from the extract of a mean fluid,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ سَوّٰىهُ وَ نَفَخَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِهٖ وَ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ الْاَفْئِدَةَ١ؕ قَلِیْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: then He duly proportioned him, and breathed into him of His spirit, and bestowed upon you ears and eyes and hearts. And yet, little thanks do you give.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِی الْاَرْضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِیْ خَلْقٍ جَدِیْدٍ١ؕ۬ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: “Shall we be created afresh after we have become lost in the earth?” Nay, the fact is that they deny that they will meet their Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِیْ وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Tell them: “The angel of death who has been charged with your souls shall gather you, and then you shall be brought back to your Lord.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ تَرٰۤى اِذِ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ نَاكِسُوْا رُءُوْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ١ؕ رَبَّنَاۤ اَبْصَرْنَا وَ سَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا اِنَّا مُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Would that you could see the guilty standing before their Lord with their heads downcast, (saying to Him): “Our Lord, we have now seen and heard, so send us back (to the world) that we might act righteously. For now we have come to have firm faith.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَاٰتَیْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدٰىهَا وَ لٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّیْ لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (They will be told): “If We had so willed, We could have bestowed guidance on every person. But the Word from Me that I will fill Hell with men and jinn, all together, has been fulfilled.

ayahs.arabicText: فَذُوْقُوْا بِمَا نَسِیْتُمْ لِقَآءَ یَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا١ۚ اِنَّا نَسِیْنٰكُمْ وَ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So taste the chastisement on account of your forgetting the encounter of this Day. We, too, have forgotten you. Taste the eternal chastisement as a requital for your misdeeds.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا یُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَا الَّذِیْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهَا خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّ سَبَّحُوْا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ هُمْ لَا یَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: None believes in Our Signs except those who, when they are given good counsel through Our verses, fall down prostrate and celebrate the praise of their Lord and do not wax proud.

ayahs.arabicText: تَتَجَافٰى جُنُوْبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ یَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَّ طَمَعًا١٘ وَّ مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ یُنْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Their sides forsake their beds, and they call upon their Lord in fear and hope, and expend (in charity) out of the sustenance We have granted them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّاۤ اُخْفِیَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ قُرَّةِ اَعْیُنٍ١ۚ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: No one knows what delights of the eyes are kept hidden for them as a reward for their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا١ؔؕ لَا یَسْتَوٗنَؐ
ayahs.translation: Would a true believer be like him who was an evil-doer? Surely they are not equal.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنّٰتُ الْمَاْوٰى١٘ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for those who believe and act righteously, theirs shall be Gardens to dwell in, a hospitality to reward them for their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا الَّذِیْنَ فَسَقُوْا فَمَاْوٰىهُمُ النَّارُ١ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اَرَادُوْۤا اَنْ یَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَاۤ اُعِیْدُوْا فِیْهَا وَ قِیْلَ لَهُمْ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِیْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for the evil-doers, their refuge shall be the Fire. Every time they want to escape from it they shall be driven back and shall be told: “Taste the chastisement of the Fire which you used to reject as a lie.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَنُذِیْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَدْنٰى دُوْنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We shall certainly have them taste some chastisement in this world in addition to the greater chastisement (of the Hereafter); perhaps they will retract (from their transgression).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا١ؕ اِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than he who is given good counsel through the Signs of his Lord and yet he turns away from them? Surely We will exact full retribution from such criminals.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَآئِهٖ وَ جَعَلْنٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَۚ
ayahs.translation: Verily We bestowed the Book upon Moses. So entertain no doubt if (the Prophet Muhammad) received the same. We had made that Book a guidance for the Children of Israel,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ اَئِمَّةً یَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْا١ؕ۫ وَ كَانُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا یُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and when they remained steadfast and firmly believed in Our Signs, We created among them leaders who guided people by Our command.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ یَفْصِلُ بَیْنَهُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ فِیْمَا كَانُوْا فِیْهِ یَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely your Lord will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection concerning the matters about which the Children of Israel used to differ.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ یَمْشُوْنَ فِیْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ١ؕ اَفَلَا یَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Did (these historical events) not make them realise that We destroyed many nations before them amidst whose dwellings they now move about? Surely there are many Signs in this. Are they unable to hear?

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اَنَّا نَسُوْقُ الْمَآءَ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا تَاْكُلُ مِنْهُ اَنْعَامُهُمْ وَ اَنْفُسُهُمْ١ؕ اَفَلَا یُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have they not seen that We drive water to the parched land, thereby bringing forth crops which they and their cattle eat? Are they unable to see?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْفَتْحُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: “If you are truthful, (tell us) when will the Judgement come?”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ یَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا یَنْفَعُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِیْمَانُهُمْ وَ لَا هُمْ یُنْظَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Tell them: “If the unbelievers were to believe on the Day of Judgement that will not avail them. For then they will be granted no respite.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَ انْتَظِرْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّنْتَظِرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: So (leave them to themselves and) turn away from them and wait; they too are waiting.
